correctness.rationale: No rational points forces each of the three quartic coefficients to take value 1 on all three F2-rational base points, giving exactly four quartics q19,q21,q25,q31 and 4^3=64 equations. Geometric smoothness is equivalent to gcd(b,(a'c+ac')^2+(b')^2ac)=1; an independent F2 polynomial GCD implementation enumerated all 64 and recovered smooth counts by b of 9,6,9,9 (total 33). An independent substitution implementation of all 36 PGL2(F2)xPGL2(F2) coordinate pairs gave exactly three orbits of sizes 9,18,6. Genus (2-1)(4-1)=3 by adjunction and Deuring–Shafarevich branch count of b gives 2-ranks 3,3,1. The enumeration is genuinely exhaustive for the specified embedded linear system, not all genus-3 curves.
residual_risks: Computer-assisted finite classification rather than a purely hand-enumerated table; independent code gives separate exact replay.
